tools.name: get_supplier_capabilities
tools.description: Returns Cintra's supported supply categories, service area, and official quote endpoints.

tools.name: validate_bom
tools.description: Checks quote lines for missing identifiers and ambiguous substitution instructions. It does not price or submit the request.

tools.name: prepare_quote_request
tools.description: Normalizes up to 500 BOM lines into Cintra's quote-ready format and returns a review link. This does not submit, purchase, reserve inventory, or create a binding quote.

tools.name: submit_quote_request
tools.description: Submits a non-binding RFQ only when production submission is enabled and the user explicitly confirms. No order is placed and no price is guaranteed.
